questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{将统计量改写成下列形式：}\quad\sqrt{\frac{n}{n+1}}\cdot\frac{X_{n+1}-\overline{X}_{n}}{S_{n}}=\frac{(X_{n+1}-\overline{X}_{n})/\sqrt{1+\frac{1}{n}\sigma}}{\sqrt{\frac{(n-1)S_{n}^{2}}{\sigma^{2}}/(n-1)}}\quad(\ast)\\&\text{由于}X_{n+1}\text{与}X_{i}(i=1,\cdots,n)\text{相互独立，}\\&\quad\overline{X}_{n}=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}X_{i}\sim N\left(\mu,\frac{\sigma^{2}}{n}\right),\quad X_{n+1}\sim N(\mu,\sigma^{2}),\\&\text{所以}X_{n+1}-\overline{X}_{n}\sim N\left(0,\left(1+\frac{1}{n}\right)\sigma^{2}\right),\text{从而}\\&\quad(X_{n+1}-\overline{X}_{n})/\left(\sqrt{1+\frac{1}{n}\sigma}\right)\sim N(0,1),\\&\text{注意到}\overline{X}_{n}\text{与}S_{n}^{2}\text{相互独立，}X_{n+1}\text{也与}S_{n}^{2}\text{相互独立，且}\\&\quad\frac{(n-1)S_{n}^{2}}{\sigma^{2}}\sim\chi^{2}(n-1),\\&\text{故由}(\ast)\text{式即得}\quad\sqrt{\frac{n}{n+1}}\cdot\frac{X_{n+1}-\overline{X}_{n}}{S_{n}}\sim t(n-1).\end{aligned}
